statusDefinitions.aligned: Panda exposes the matching semantic token with the Catalog value.
statusDefinitions.override: Panda exposes the semantic token, but the current value differs and requires a reviewed ConfigProvider override.
statusDefinitions.gap: No safe Panda semantic token or current project override exists. Do not substitute an approximate color.

--ui-color-page.projectOverride: No global page-background override. apps/mintaka/theme/themeConfig.ts currently provides token: {}.
--ui-color-page.notes: Panda colorBgLayout is a layout surface and does not equal the Catalog white page. Keep the canvas layout-owned until a product-wide theme decision exists.

--ui-color-card.projectOverride: Panda generated default in components/theme/themes/shared/genColorMapToken.ts; no app override.
--ui-color-card.notes: Exact white card and focused-surface token.

--ui-color-title.projectOverride: Panda generated default; apps/alnitak TeacherIntro TAB_THEME applies the same value to Tabs only.
--ui-color-title.notes: Exact strong-title token. Use it for headings and other confirmed strong text roles.

--ui-color-text.projectOverride: Panda generated default; ProfileSettingsClient has a scoped legacy colorText override with the same value.

--ui-color-secondary.projectOverride: No application override. Panda default is #9C9CAC, not the Catalog #767687.
--ui-color-secondary.notes: Use a reviewed ConfigProvider theme override only where secondary text must match Catalog; do not substitute the placeholder token.

--ui-color-placeholder.projectOverride: Panda generated default in components/theme/themes/shared/genColorMapToken.ts; no app override.

--ui-color-disabled.projectOverride: No application override for the Catalog #C7CBD3 disabled text value.
--ui-color-disabled.notes: Panda exposes the semantic disabled token, but its current derived value is not the Catalog value. In ConfigProvider, set colorTextQuaternary because colorTextDisabled is derived from it.

--ui-color-border.projectOverride: Panda generated default in components/theme/themes/shared/genColorMapToken.ts; no app override.
--ui-color-border.notes: Exact default input and component boundary token.

--ui-color-divider.projectOverride: Panda generated default in components/theme/themes/shared/genColorMapToken.ts; no app override.
--ui-color-divider.notes: Exact quiet internal divider and light fill token.

--ui-color-hover.projectOverride: No application override for the Catalog #EBEDF1 hover surface.
--ui-color-hover.notes: Panda exposes a hover-fill token, but its generated default differs from Catalog. In ConfigProvider, set colorFill because colorFillContentHover is derived from it.

--ui-color-primary.projectOverride: Panda generated default is #FF4438; no application override aligns it to the Catalog #FF4338.
--ui-color-primary.notes: Use the custom Panda primary-main token for red CTA behavior; a reviewed theme override is required for the exact Catalog value.

--ui-color-primary-hover.projectOverride: Panda generated default in components/theme/themes/shared/genColorMapToken.ts; no app override.
--ui-color-primary-hover.notes: Exact red hover, pressed, and destructive color.

--ui-color-primary-shade-1.projectOverride: Panda generated default is #FF7B73, not the Catalog #FF8E87.
--ui-color-primary-shade-1.notes: Use an explicit reviewed override for the lower-priority warm accent.

--ui-color-link.projectOverride: No application override. Panda derives its link color from the info seed by default.
--ui-color-link.notes: Panda supports the semantic link token, but it must be overridden to the Catalog #59779A.

--ui-color-link-hover.projectOverride: No application override for the Catalog #4B647D link hover value.
--ui-color-link-hover.notes: Set only alongside the approved link theme decision; do not derive an arbitrary darker color locally.

--ui-color-info.projectOverride: Panda seed default in components/theme/themes/seed.ts; no app override.

--ui-color-info-surface.projectOverride: No application override for the Catalog #EDFAFA information surface.
--ui-color-info-surface.notes: Panda supports the semantic information background but its generated value must be verified or overridden.

--ui-color-accessory-1.projectOverride: No application override for the Catalog #FFF9E6 warning-derived accessory surface.
--ui-color-accessory-1.notes: Use only where the Catalog role is warning-related; otherwise retain it as a local approved accessory surface.

--ui-color-accessory-2.projectOverride: No Panda semantic token or application override represents this #E6F7F8 decorative accessory surface.
--ui-color-accessory-2.notes: Do not replace it with colorInfoBg without an approved semantic decision.

--ui-color-accessory-3.projectOverride: Panda generated default in components/theme/themes/shared/genColorMapToken.ts; no app override.

--ui-color-accessory-4.projectOverride: No Panda semantic token or application override represents this #E7FCF5 accessory surface.
--ui-color-accessory-4.notes: Do not treat an accessory color as Panda success without an approved semantic decision.

--ui-color-available.projectOverride: No Panda availability token or product-wide availability theme override exists.
--ui-color-available.notes: Availability is a booking-domain state, not a substitute for Panda success.

--ui-color-available-surface.projectOverride: No Panda availability-surface token or product-wide availability theme override exists.
--ui-color-available-surface.notes: Keep this as a Calendar or booking adapter token until an availability theme contract is approved.

--ui-color-available-current-day-surface.projectOverride: No Panda current-availability-day token or product-wide availability theme override exists.
--ui-color-available-current-day-surface.notes: Calendar current-day availability remains a documented booking adapter concern.

--ui-color-success.projectOverride: Panda seed default in components/theme/themes/seed.ts; no app override.

--ui-color-success-surface.projectOverride: No application override for the Catalog #ECFFF9 success surface.
--ui-color-success-surface.notes: Panda supports the semantic success background but its generated value must be verified or overridden.

--ui-color-warning.projectOverride: Panda seed default in components/theme/themes/seed.ts; no app override.

--ui-color-warning-surface.projectOverride: No application override for the Catalog #FFF9E6 warning surface.
--ui-color-warning-surface.notes: Panda supports the semantic warning background but its generated value must be verified or overridden.

--ui-color-error.projectOverride: Panda seed default in components/theme/themes/seed.ts; no app override.

--ui-color-error-surface.projectOverride: No application override for the Catalog #FFF1F1 error surface.
--ui-color-error-surface.notes: Use the semantic error background token only after its value is aligned through a reviewed theme decision.

--ui-color-on-primary.projectOverride: Panda generated default resolves to colorWhite; no app override.

--ui-color-modal-mask.projectOverride: No application override. Panda default is a 45% black mask, not the Catalog title-color 24% mask.
--ui-color-modal-mask.notes: Use the semantic mask token only with an approved overlay theme override.

--ui-color-upload-overlay.projectOverride: No global Panda token or project override defines the Catalog upload overlay alpha.
--ui-color-upload-overlay.notes: This is Upload-specific feedback treatment and requires an approved component-level token or adapter.

--ui-color-upload-loading.projectOverride: No global Panda token or project override defines the Catalog upload loading alpha.
--ui-color-upload-loading.notes: This is Upload-specific loading treatment and requires an approved component-level token or adapter.

--ui-color-on-primary-muted.projectOverride: No Panda semantic token or project override represents this 45% white content treatment.
--ui-color-on-primary-muted.notes: Do not approximate with disabled text; it is contextual on-color content.

--ui-color-on-emphasis-muted.projectOverride: No Panda semantic token or project override represents this 55% white content treatment.
--ui-color-on-emphasis-muted.notes: Do not approximate with disabled text; it is contextual on-emphasis content.

--ui-color-emphasis-weak.projectOverride: No Panda semantic token or project override represents this title-color alpha treatment.
--ui-color-emphasis-weak.notes: This requires an approved component-level treatment rather than a generic Panda color substitution.

--ui-color-disabled-weak.projectOverride: No Panda semantic token or project override represents this disabled alpha treatment.
--ui-color-disabled-weak.notes: This requires an approved component-level treatment rather than a generic Panda color substitution.

--ui-color-hover-overlay.projectOverride: No Panda semantic token or project override represents this title-color hover overlay.
--ui-color-hover-overlay.notes: Use only through a reviewed component interaction token; do not replace it with an arbitrary grey.
